name: chess-improvement-app
description: Personalized chess improvement app: analyze chess.com games, get custom puzzles from your own mistakes, and follow a lesson plan tailored to your weaknesses.

scripts.install:all: npm install && npm install --prefix server && npm install --prefix client
scripts.dev: concurrently -n SERVER,CLIENT -c blue,green "npm run dev --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix client"
